title: Fubini bound for the cylinder over a set of centres (corrected printed (5) of 5.1)
statement: Let ι be a finite index set and J ⊆ ι, let E_ι := EuclideanSpace ℝ ι and E_J := EuclideanSpace ℝ J carry their Lebesgue measures L^ι and L^J, and let π_J : E_ι → E_J, π_J(a) := (a_i)_{i∈J}. Then for every set B ⊆ E_J (not necessarily measurable), L^ι({a ∈ E_ι : 0 ≤ a_i ≤ 1 for all i ∈ ι, and π_J(a) ∈ B}) ≤ L^J(B), both sides being outer Lebesgue measures.
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (J : Finset ι) (B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)), volume {a : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι | (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ 1) ∧ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : J => a i) ∈ B} ≤ volume B
